text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of summer camp,
where racers
train to improve their skills.

That should be everyone. Do you all
have your
seat belts on?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Good! We're ready to leave now, driver!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Was the card you picked... the ace of
hearts?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! It's not that hard. It's all just an
illusion!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
D-dang, that's cool! Man, I wish I could
do tricks
like that too!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Haha! If you'd like, I can teach you
tonight.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Wait, teach me too! I want to know too!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Of course. You can all come
over
tonight!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's summer camp starts off
blazing hot!
